about: Streams and school sizes (gun side). Now and then small fish come as a stream instead of one block: one at a time along a route for several seconds. kinds: ribbon = one route, twin = a route and its mirror taking turns (a crossing X), wheel = a loop in the middle. chance = per spawn decision for that group once the gap has passed; gap = seconds between streams; every = seconds between fish; dur = how long a stream runs. schoolDeck = Sardine school sizes [[min, max], weight] so schools come in many sizes, not always 6-9. twinChance = chance a Sardine school gets a mirrored twin. Show only: each fish keeps its own catch chance and pay.
